title: UniSAFE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Unified Multimodal Models

bias_targets.target: Protected Class Bias (Race, Religion, Gender, Disability)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial multimodal prompts (text, image, and multi-turn combinations) designed to elicit slurs, dehumanizing language, and stereotypes targeting protected groups. The benchmark measures the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Risk Rating of generating hateful or discriminatory content.
